title: Equil 5.4 - factory limit of basal rate 1.5 U/h?
body:
Problem with setting the basal rate above 1.5 U/h – the pump refuses to accept a profile in which the basal rate exceeds 1.5 (even if it is a temporary dose). This is not a matter of therapy safeguards (max_basal, max_iob) – these are set much higher. 

Several people have reported a similar problem on internet forums. In Equil 5.4, the factory limit for the pump is probably set to 1.5 U/h. It is easy to change on the factory remote control (even up to 35 U/h), but unfortunately, after unpairing with the remote control and pairing with AAPS, the pump seems to return to the standard limit 1.5.
I use AAPS 3.3.2.1 - fully looped for 5 years (so far with Dash, but I was planning to switch to Equil).


Janusz

comments.body: this is probably already resolved in dev and will be part of next release
